incorrect_inferences: The first pass was uncertain whether STEADY was required; the authored route uses it to power the ferry, stabilize both bridges, open Isp’s route, and counter Cana during traversal.
The first pass treated the shutdown panel mainly as a route puzzle; source confirms the separate two-second boss charge, while both-exit feasibility still needs the route.
changed_judgments: Reasoning rises 2 to 3 because the full route has sequential dependencies across STOP, STEADY, RESCUE, blue gate/support effects, then the paired target charge; the score does not come from treating the hold duration itself as complex reasoning.
Cooperation remains 3: distinct necessary Isp/Pac route roles culminate in the explicit simultaneous two-second owner-target hold.
Execution rises 2 to 3 because the source and route require ferry boarding, jumps across elevated spans and a gap, and separated target positions near hazards.
Timing remains 2: the separate two-second hold and cyclic ferry/attacks require coordination, but the hold is explicit and stable rather than a narrow one-shot window.
Hazards changes from unknown to 3 because source defines two slime floors and a pulsing tumor core that harm players; source simulation ends a run on contact.

Novelty remains 2 but is revised for actual prior exposure: level_16 and immediate predecessor level_19 already teach STOP/STEADY/RESCUE and paired targets; the new element is the two-second charge and dual-attacker traversal.
Recovery changes from unknown to 2 because ferry/attack mistakes are repeatable, whereas contacting an active harmful hazard ends the attempt; no failed human run measures actual retry burden.
Clarity remains burden 2: the target instruction is explicit, but the full sequence of route pads and interruptions is not all explained in first-view text.
unresolved: The idle packet does not show any action; source and native traces establish mechanics but not first-time learning.
The completed route has no deaths and does not quantify timing errors, hazard exposure, or retry counts.
Two-human shared-keyboard reliability remains unmeasured; control friction is null.

single_operator_note: A single operator would need to sequence Isp’s STOP/RESCUE/blue target with Pac’s ferry/STEADY traversal and orange target, then sustain both targets for two seconds. That switching burden is separate from the two-human scores.
